provenance.comparison: Retrospective through the 2026-10-27 UTC signal candle; 2026 history had been inspected and is not a blind period.
provenance.historical_funding: All-history account totals and curves use fee-only net_pct; historical funded/proxy values are omitted from event fields and excluded from primary totals.
provenance.time_semantics: Event and member entry_time values are UTC 5-minute candle open timestamps; corresponding entry prices are that candle's open fills.

costs.funding: Included in the separate 2026 actual-funded summary and event field only; not mixed into all-history fee-only results.

btc_medium.confirmation: at least 75% of initially touched tradable altcoins reclaimed the lower band

exit.remaining_leg_fill: market stop or deadline; taker fee

alt.member_selection: initial lower-touch altcoin constituents; the original membership is retained per event
alt.member_weighting: equal dollar per constituent at entry
alt.exit: each constituent exits at its own 6h open price

calendar_year_fee_only_reset.return_basis: fee-only; sleeve equity resets at January 1
